name: Studied Mind
description: Gain proficiency in Investigation or History. If you already have proficiency, gain expertise instead.

name: Divine Lore
description: When you successfully research a creature, location, religion, or historical subject, ask the GM one additional question about the information discovered.

name: Read the Signs
description: Once per short rest, when using Insight, Investigation, History, or Religion, you may draw an additional card and add it for the check.

name: Sacred Scholar
description: Learn any Tier 1 spell. This spell is added to the spells available to your character and is considered a cleric spell. All other casting costs still apply.

name: Theologic Identification
description: When identifying or researching a magical effect, you may burn a heart to learn its properties and secretes without risking triggering a trap effect or a curse.

name: Secrets Seer
description: Once per short rest, when you uncover information about an enemy using Arcane Insight, you may reveal one additional useful weakness, resistance, motivation, or capability.

name: Empowered Divine Magic
description: Your cleric spell casting attack bonus increases by +1 and your spell save DC increases by +1

name: Prophetic Insight
description: Once per long rest, ask the GM a single question about an immediate danger, creature, or situation. The GM must provide a truthful but appropriately limited answer.  This feature cannot be used to glean additional information on the same topic.

name: Master of Lore
description: Gain expertise in one of the following skills that you are proficient: Arcana, History, Investigation, or Religion.

name: Ancient Knowledge
description: When you successfully research a subject, the GM may provide a deeper connection to the world: a forgotten weakness, lost location, ancient name, hidden faction, or other significant revelation.

name: Divine Warrior
description: Gain proficiency with an additional weapon type.

name: Armored Faith
description: Gain proficiency with Heavy Armor.

name: Battle Prayer
description: Before making a Might attack, you may burn any card additional card to add +1 to the attack.

name: Phalanx Shielding
description: When you use Dodge, you may protect an adjacent ally instead of yourself.

name: Battlefield Chaplain
description: When an ally within close range reaches 0 HP, as a Reaction you may immediately use an appropriate Divine ability or spell that restores HP if you can pay its cost.

name: Rallying Faith
description: When you use Rallying Cry, one of the affected allies may also recover 1 HP.

name: Divine Retribution
description: Once per short rest, when an enemy damages you, you may burn a Heart and use your Reaction to make an immediate Might attack against that enemy.

name: Unbreakable Faith
description: When you would be reduced to 0 HP, burn a Heart. You remain at 1 HP instead. Once used, this feat cannot be used again until a Long Rest.

name: Paragorn of War
description: All Face cards are also Hearts in additional to their shown suit. When determining the outcome of an effect, the card can only use one suit.

name: Channel Divinity: Knowledge of the Ancients
description: Gain a new way to use your channel divinity feature. Burning a 2 allows you to gain expertise in a skill until the next short rest.

name: Channel Divinity: Arcane Infusion
description: Change the damage type of your weapon to that of your choosing. The damage type lasts until the next short rest or use this feature again.
